user.title: Add a school
user.description:
School Day reads each school's calendar (school year, days off, special days and bell times) from a YAML file in your configuration folder. If the file doesn't exist yet, a commented starter file is created for you to edit.

Tip: an AI assistant can turn your school's calendar PDF into this file. See the prompt in the documentation.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. "Rose Hill Elementary" or "Emma's school".
data_description.file: Path relative to your configuration folder. Leave empty to use {folder}/<school name>.yaml.

error.invalid_file: The calendar file could not be loaded: {error}
error.invalid_path: Use a .yaml file inside your configuration folder, e.g. school_day/my_school.yaml.

abort.already_configured: This calendar file is already in use.

create_entry.starter_file: A starter calendar was written to `{file}` in your configuration folder. Open it in the File editor or Studio Code Server and fill in your school's dates and bell times. Changes are picked up automatically.

invalid_file.message: Could not load the calendar file {file}: {error}

not_in_yaml.message: School {school_id} is no longer defined in configuration.yaml.

invalid_file.title: School calendar for {name} has an error

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reloads all schools from configuration.yaml and their calendar files.
